replication_status: approximate (print -18.686, N 2,216; shipped data and code give -18.2602, N 2,243-2,247; coefficient 2.3% smaller in absolute value, 0.02 printed SEs)
notes: Table2to5.do lines 147-157: preserve; drop if EUWeb==0; drop if after_gdpr==0; bys id_web: egen anycm=sum(ConsentMechanism); reghdfe url_gdelt ConsentMechanism if anycm>0, absorb(i.wave_num i.id_web) cluster(id_web). Outcome: number of new articles per wave (GDELT). Published value from the article (see published_source); the six-column layout is confirmed by the article (the shipped do-file resets global dvs to url_gdelt before Table 5, so it produces only column 1). Sample: 316 EU websites, waves 26-34 (post-GDPR), 2,838 site-waves (2,247 non-missing for url_gdelt and reaction_mean). Treatment = ConsentMechanism (1 if the site displays a cookie-consent mechanism in that wave). g_t5 = first wave in 26-34 with ConsentMechanism==1: 118 websites at wave 26 (always treated in this window; 50 of them in every wave), 198 switch on at waves 27-34 (8 cohorts); no never-treated units. 373 post-adoption site-waves have the indicator switched off and are dropped via sample_filter (Hull fn 6); on the retained rows 1[wave>=g_t5]==ConsentMechanism. gvar is used instead of treat_var so that adoption is dated from the treatment path rather than from rows with non-missing outcome. Because of the switch-off drop the runner TWFE differs from the published coefficient by construction (check against fixest on the trimmed sample); fixest on the same trimmed sample gives -32.6489 (SE 25.633), N 1972 after singletons.
published_source: Article (Management Science 72(3), 2026) Table 5 'Look-Ahead Matching: Consent Mechanism', column (1): -18.686 (18.218), Observations 2,216. Shipped Table2to5.do line 154 (reghdfe url_gdelt ConsentMechanism if anycm>0, absorb(i.wave_num i.id_web) cluster(id_web)) re-run in Stata 16.1: -18.260201 (SE 16.708452), N 2,243. The printed SEs and N come from areg-type estimation (absorbed site FE counted in the degrees of freedom, singletons kept): areg url_gdelt ConsentMechanism i.wave_num if anycm>0, absorb(id_web) vce(cluster id_web) gives SE 17.84048, N 2,247; the coefficient is the same -18.2602, so column (1) differs from the print in the data: the article uses 2,216 site-waves vs 2,247 non-missing url_gdelt rows in the shipped file (31 rows; presumably an earlier GDELT pull).
